articles.headline: Harry Kane breaks another record in 100th Bundesliga appearance for Bayern Munich
articles.description: Harry Kane scored his 102nd goal in his 100th Bundesliga game on Saturday, the most by any player in the league's history after a century of appearances.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich go top of Bundesliga after 6-1 thrashing of RB Leipzig
articles.description: Bayern Munich warmed up for their Champions League showdown against Arsenal with a thumping 6-1 home victory over RB Leipzig to reclaim top spot in the Bundesliga.

articles.headline: Borussia Dortmund extend head coach Niko Kovač's contract through to 2029
articles.description: Borussia Dortmund have handed head coach Niko Kovač a contact extension through June 2029 as a reward for stabilizing the team.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich salvage point at Augbsurg after conceding fastest ever Bundesliga goal
articles.description: Bayern Munich salvaged a 2-2 draw against Augsburg after a blunder from Manuel Neuer led to them conceding the fastest goal in Bundesliga history.
